facts.fact: 大风天醒来，窗外是昏暗灰蒙的一天
facts.anchor: I pulled back the curtains to find a dark grey day

facts.fact: 出门前 Alexander 在她额头留下罕见的一吻
facts.anchor: he planted a rare kiss upon my forehead before leaving

facts.fact: 他房间挂的三幅画之一：一个完全笼罩在阴影中的带角巨兽
facts.anchor: The first showed a large horned creature, entirely cast in shadow

facts.fact: 内室有焦糊味，夹杂铁锈味
facts.anchor: The scent of charring was sharper here, with an undertone of rust

facts.fact: 她发烧昏倒后，Alexander 破门而入救她
facts.anchor: Alexander broke down the door, it seems

facts.fact: 发烧期间她曾醒来，看见 Alexander 在阴影中持刀抵着她的喉咙
facts.anchor: to find Alexander, face in shadows, holding a knife to my throat

facts.fact: 他带她到家族陵墓，凝视门内的黑暗
facts.anchor: he said, keeping his eyes on the darkness beyond the door

facts.fact: 结尾她感到两人之间出现越来越大的鸿沟
facts.anchor: If before there had been distance between us, a stilted formality, now there seemed to be a gulf
